messages:
elaine_cs: Quick check — onboarding call with WellSpring at 10am tomorrow. They want final wording for uptime, p95 latency, and how credits will be calculated. Can we confirm the numbers we present?

sam_ops: Proposed SLA in contract is 99.9% uptime, p95 latency < 250ms for hosted plan, credit tiering: 0.25% credit per 30m below threshold up to 5% total. Is that still accurate?

luca_eng: That's the default for hosted. For high-throughput routes they may need p95 at 200ms — we can offer a dedicated pool quote but not in onboarding doc unless they ask.

elaine_cs: Got it. Client expectation is 'enterprise-grade' but they're starting on hosted. Jamie, do we want to present an example credit calc in the onboarding deck? A tiny worked example helps legal/commercial.

jamie_csm: Yes please — customers always ask for a concrete example. Suggest we show a 24h window example: uptime 99.5 -> credit x, p95 breach -> credit y, plus how overlapping incidents are counted. Keep it simple.

sam_ops: I'll draft the example. Use this formula we use internally: 

```
credit_percent = min( max( (SLO_target - observed_uptime) / SLO_target * 100, 0 ), max_credit)
```

Then show an applied numeric example.

luca_eng: Also note: latency SLOs are measured per-route; we need to call out that heavy batch / long-seq jobs are excluded. Add line: "Latency measured on interactive inference endpoints (text-gen api) at 1-2k tokens window."

elaine_cs: Good call. Can someone pull last 90d baseline for p95 and error incidence to reassure them? They asked if our historical uptime ever dipped into credit territory.

reports-bot: 2950012350 — Generated SLO baseline report: 90d hosted avg uptime 99.94%, p95 latency 180ms, 3 incidents >5min (none triggered credit thresholds). Report link: https://reports.internal/r/2950012350

jamie_csm: Perfect — that link + one-pager should be enough. Action items: @sam_ops create one-pager + example calc, @luca_eng add the route-exclusion note and confirm dedicated offer wording, @elaine_cs I will add these to the deck and send to WellSpring pre-call.

sam_ops: I'll put a draft in #docs-review by 4pm PT today. Draft will include: simple credit table, example calc, definition of measurement windows, and contact for incident evidence requests.

luca_eng: Draft language for dedicated offer: "Customers requiring stricter latency SLOs may enroll in Redwood Dedicated — predictable capacity and per-route p95 targets available via contract." Short and non-committal.

elaine_cs: Thanks team. If we get any push on retroactive credits, point them to the evidence bundle process and the SLA credit cap. I'll run through the deck with legal if they poke on wording. 👍

jamie_csm: Heads up — on renewal this customer usually escalates on credits. Recommend adding a note to the account health tracker to flag them 60 days pre-renewal. I'll add a tag.

sam_ops: Note for onboarding doc: include the command snippet for customers to request incident evidence: 

```
redwood-cli incidents request-evidence --customer wellsprint --window 2024-01-01,2024-03-31
```

(we can localize example dates)

elaine_cs: Love it. Last ask: can reports-bot attach the small CSV of daily uptime for last 30d so I can paste into the slide?

reports-bot: 2950012388 — Attached: wellsprint_uptime_30d.csv (s3://reports/wellsprint/uptime_30d.csv)

luca_eng: One more tiny thing — include a short sentence: "Automatic fallback to compatible model variants may affect latency; documented in deployment notes." Avoid surprises.

elaine_cs: Great. I'll assemble the deck and ping here when ready for a quick review (5–10m) before the call. Thanks all :rocket:
